import os,sys,json,time,hashlib,platform
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path("/Users/saisreed/Desktop/Coding/house-edge-codex")
RESULTS=Path(os.environ.get("S5_NESTED_OUT",ROOT/"docs/sai/results"));REPORTS=RESULTS.parent/"reports"
os.chdir(ROOT);sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/"docs/sai"))
from harness import load_split,read_pred_csv,evaluate,diff_ci,blend_gain,smoke_split
from harness.scoring import audit_episodes,scope_episodes
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
import harness.data as hd
# Match the established read-only dense cache location.
hd.CACHE=Path("/Users/saisreed/Desktop/Coding/TamuDatathon26-PSAZZ/docs/sai/cache")
common=json.loads((ROOT/"docs/sai/results/W3W4_COMMON.json").read_text())["source"]
ns={"__name__":"nested_validation_common"};exec(compile(common,"W3W4_COMMON.json","exec"),ns)
D=ns["load_features"]();V=ns["load_validation"]()
saved=json.loads((ROOT/"docs/sai/results/S5.json").read_text())
CFG=saved["params"]["config"];H=float(saved["params"]["hyper"])
B=read_pred_csv(ROOT/"docs/sai/preds/B3_validation.csv",V)
Xfull=ns["cell_X"](D["va"],CFG)
assert Xfull.shape[0]==V.n
QPOS={q:i for i,q in enumerate(V.qid)}
def norm(p):
 p=np.maximum(np.asarray(p,float),1e-6);return p/p.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)
def folds(eps):
 ordered=sorted(eps,key=lambda e:hashlib.sha256(("fold-v1|"+str(e)).encode()).hexdigest())
 return {e:i%6 for i,e in enumerate(ordered)}
def model_predict(tr,te,X,Bq,truth):
 m=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),Ridge(alpha=H))
 m.fit(X[tr],truth[tr]-Bq[tr])
 return norm(Bq[te]+m.predict(X[te]))
def nested(split,idx,base,scope, smoke=False):
 episodes=list(scope_episodes(split,scope))
 fold=folds(episodes)
 rows_by_ep={e:split.episode_rows(e) for e in episodes}
 allrows=np.concatenate([rows_by_ep[e] for e in episodes])
 ep=np.asarray(split.episode)
 Pm=base.copy()
 inner_weights=[]
 for outer in range(6):
  outer_eps=[e for e in episodes if fold[e]==outer]
  train_eps=[e for e in episodes if fold[e]!=outer]
  outer_rows=np.concatenate([rows_by_ep[e] for e in outer_eps])
  train_rows=np.concatenate([rows_by_ep[e] for e in train_eps])
  # Member prediction on the held outer fold, fit on all other dev episodes.
  Pm[outer_rows]=model_predict(train_rows,outer_rows,idx,base,split.truth)
  inner=folds(train_eps)
  for k in range(6):
   held=[e for e in train_eps if inner[e]==k]
   if not held: continue
   fit_eps=[e for e in train_eps if inner[e]!=k]
   te=np.concatenate([rows_by_ep[e] for e in held])
   tr=np.concatenate([rows_by_ep[e] for e in fit_eps])
   Pm[te]=model_predict(tr,te,idx,base,split.truth)
  # Fit blend weights only through harness; retain this outer fold's OOF rows.
  gain=blend_gain(Pm,base,split,scope=scope,folds=6,bootstrap=100,grid=21)
  inner_weights.append(float(gain["w_per_fold"][outer]))
  # Lock only this outer fold's predictions in final aggregate.
  if outer==0:out=base.copy()
  out[outer_rows]=gain["oof"][outer_rows]
 return out,inner_weights
def execute_smoke():
 sm=smoke_split(V);vrows=np.asarray([QPOS[q] for q in sm.qid]);Xs=Xfull[vrows];Bs=B[vrows]
 out,w=nested(sm,Xs,Bs,"smoke",True)
 return {"episodes":len(sm.episodes),"rows":sm.n,"outer_fold_weights":w,"points":evaluate(out,sm,"smoke",bootstrap=0)["points"]}
def execute_full():
 start=time.monotonic();eps=scope_episodes(V,"dev")
 # Full validation-sized target array; audit labels/truth are never referenced.
 devrows=np.concatenate([V.episode_rows(e) for e in eps])
 pred=B.copy();pred,weights=nested(V,Xfull,B,"dev")
 audit=set(audit_episodes(V));auditrows=np.flatnonzero(np.isin(V.episode,list(audit)))
 trainmask=np.isin(V.episode,eps);m=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),Ridge(alpha=H))
 m.fit(Xfull[trainmask],V.truth[trainmask]-B[trainmask])
 p_audit=norm(B[auditrows]+m.predict(Xfull[auditrows]))
 meanw=float(np.mean(weights));pred[auditrows]=norm(meanw*p_audit+(1-meanw)*B[auditrows])
 detpred,detweights=nested(V,Xfull,B,"dev")
 detpred[auditrows]=norm(meanw*p_audit+(1-meanw)*B[auditrows])
 det=float(np.max(np.abs(pred-detpred)));assert det<1e-8,(det,detweights,weights)
 ev=evaluate(pred,V,"dev",bootstrap=1000);diff=diff_ci(pred,B,V,"dev",bootstrap=1000)
 from harness.results import to_csv
 RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);to_csv(RESULTS/"preds/S5_NESTED_validation.csv",V,pred)
 doc={"id":"S5_NESTED","description":"Fixed S5 hyperparameters with nested episode-grouped inner member fitting and outer harness blend cross-fitting; diagnostic only","params":{"config":CFG,"hyper":H,"outer_folds":6,"inner_folds":6,"blend_grid":21,"blend_bootstrap":100},"scope":"dev","points":ev["points"],"ci95":ev["ci95"],"condition_ratios":ev["condition_ratios"],"R":ev["R"],"class_error_shares":ev["class_error_shares"],"diff_vs_B3":diff,"outer_fold_weights":weights,"mean_outer_weight":meanw,"determinism_max_diff":det,"runtime_seconds":time.monotonic()-start,"python":platform.python_version(),"numpy":np.__version__,"audit_scoring":False,"audit_forecast":"full dev fitted member blended with B3 at mean of six outer weights; no audit truth read","fold_membership":{str(e):int(folds(eps)[e]) for e in eps},"smoke":SMOKE,"source":Path("/private/tmp/s5_nested.py").read_text(),"caveat":"Selected S5 configuration/hyperparameter were chosen globally on dev and remain optimistic; this diagnostic fixes them and nests member/weight fitting only."}
 (RESULTS/"S5_NESTED.json").write_text(json.dumps(doc,indent=1,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
 report=["S5_NESTED: fixed selected S5 configuration/hyperparameter; nested diagnostic only.",f"Outer/inner episode folds: 6/6; blend weights selected by harness grid of 21; weight bootstrap 100.",f"Smoke: 24 dev episodes, 6 folds; points={SMOKE['points']:.6f}; runtime={SMOKE['runtime_seconds']:.3f}s.",f"Full dev points={ev['points']:.6f}; CI95={ev['ci95']}; paired vs B3={diff}.",f"Condition ratios={json.dumps(ev['condition_ratios'],sort_keys=True)}.",f"Class error shares={json.dumps(ev['class_error_shares'],sort_keys=True)}.",f"Outer weights={weights}; mean={meanw:.6f}; determinism max difference={det:.2e}.",f"Runtime={doc['runtime_seconds']:.3f}s; Python {platform.python_version()}; NumPy {np.__version__}; stdlib-only=no.", "Audit forecast uses full dev fit blended at mean outer weight; audit truth not read or scored.",doc["caveat"],"Full-validation predictions saved in results/preds/S5_NESTED_validation.csv."]
 REPORTS.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(REPORTS/"S5_NESTED.md").write_text("\n".join(report)+"\n")
 print(json.dumps({"id":"S5_NESTED","points":ev["points"],"ci95":ev["ci95"],"diff":diff,"weights":weights,"runtime":doc["runtime_seconds"],"det":det}))
if __name__=="__main__":
 phase=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else "full"
 SMOKE={"runtime_seconds":0.0,"points":0.0}
 if phase=="smoke":
  t=time.monotonic();SMOKE=execute_smoke();SMOKE["runtime_seconds"]=time.monotonic()-t;print(json.dumps({"smoke":SMOKE}))
 else:
  t=time.monotonic();SMOKE=execute_smoke();SMOKE["runtime_seconds"]=time.monotonic()-t
  assert SMOKE["episodes"]==24 and np.isfinite(SMOKE["points"])
  execute_full()
